title: Pager journal-mode change readiness

scope.rationale: sqlite3PagerOkToChangeJournalMode permits a journal-mode change only before the writer cache is modified and while no open journal has written content.

external_source_responsibilities: Pager state and journal open/offset fields remain internally consistent
dependencies.caller_closure: The complete readiness predicate is assigned and observes the production Pager state used by journal mutation paths.

contracts.state_and_results: False at writer-cache-modified or later. False for an open journal with positive offset. True otherwise.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Caller owns Pager synchronization. No callbacks or I/O.

representation_differences: Zig uses the typed PagerState enum and bool result instead of ordered C constants and int.

oracle.protocol: Observe true in reader state with closed journal, false in writer-cache-modified state, and false in reader state with an open nonempty journal.

assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No I/O; caller owns Pager synchronization.

integration.native_call_path: The predicate reads the same state and journal fields maintained by begin-write, open-journal, commit, rollback, and end-transaction paths.

independent_review.notes: Requires pinned-C state matrix, assurance closure, and independent review.

known_blockers: Add pinned-C readiness matrix over every Pager writer state and journal offset boundary.

implementation_spans: upstream/sqlite/src/pager.c:7490-7512 and journal-mode callers were reviewed
src/core/internal/pager_core.zig PagerState, journal fields, write/commit/rollback paths, and tests were reviewed
callees: Typed enum/order and field checks in Zig
